Q: Lottie blend issue in flutter A:

✅ FIX #1 (Best): BackdropFilter isolation (transparent)

This forces an offscreen buffer without visible background.

BackdropFilter(
  filter: ImageFilter.blur(sigmaX: 0, sigmaY: 0),
  child: AnimatedEmojiWidget(
    codepoint: widget.emojiCodepoint,
    size: widget.emojiSize,
    loop: true,
  ),
)

Why this works:

  • BackdropFilter always creates a saveLayer

  • Even with 0 blur

  • Difference blend now samples only the emoji buffer

✔ No black circle
✔ No visual change
✔ No blend-through
✔ Used in many production apps
